Program_Info.Program_Change_Info: diagnostics: add the sensor tree as read when the ZIP is collected; diagnostics: what the dashboard shows, when a GPU reading drops, driver resets and sleep; gpu: show when the chosen graphics card isn't read; lighting: drive Razer, HyperX and SteelSeries devices on their own protocols; release: thank the contributors by name on the GitHub release; status: show a global shortcut another program already holds; updates: an update channel for release candidates; gpu: handle an empty engine type in GPU Engine instance names; gpu: leave USB display adapters out of the GPU list; header: drop the profile chip's dot and keep its size on hover; installer: start RIGStats as the signed-in user, not the account that approved UAC; lighting: drive LampArrays without an intensity channel, and wait out Razer's "not taken up yet" [#538](https://github.com/dvalfrid/rigstats/issues/538); ram: show the real data rate on boards that report the speed in MHz; release: hold a new release back until its installer and latest.json are up; sensors: say why the CPU values are empty when PawnIO is missing; sensors: stop counting sleep as a hardware worker hang; settings: keep floating mode turned on over the desktop wallpaper; tray: draw the Control Center icon as a whole dial; wallpaper: restart the host when a new desktop background destroys its window; app: let the tray thread rest, and ping only for someone who looks; app: read the process list in one Windows call per tick; app: read the process list without a thread pool, halving idle CPU; app: two tokio workers, and a release profile with thin LTO; battery: ask Windows whether there is a battery, WMI only when there is one; battery: ask WMI about the battery once a minute on a PC without one; recording: parse the sessions index only when it changed; tools: measure what RIGStats costs the PC and record a baseline

English.Char_Desc_45: Hardware monitor & control center for Windows
English.Char_Desc_80: Live CPU/GPU stats, game overlay, fan curves, RGB and auto-switching profiles.
English.Char_Desc_250: RIGStats is a lightweight, open-source hardware monitor and control center for Windows: real-time CPU, GPU, RAM, storage and network telemetry in an always-visible overlay, plus fan curves, power profiles and RGB lighting.
English.Char_Desc_450: RIGStats is a lightweight, open-source hardware monitor and control center for Windows. It displays real-time telemetry for your entire rig - CPU, GPU, RAM, storage, network and system power - in a clean, always-visible overlay, and its Control Center sets fan curves, power profiles and RGB lighting. Profiles switch by themselves while a game runs and set fans, power limits, lighting, the desktop background and Wallpaper Engine.
English.Char_Desc_2000: RIGStats is a lightweight, open-source hardware monitor and control center for Windows. It displays real-time telemetry for your entire rig - CPU, GPU, RAM, storage, network and system power - in a clean, always-visible overlay, and its Control Center sets fan curves, power profiles and RGB lighting. Features sparkline panels, portrait/landscape profiles, wallpaper mode, floating overlay, in-game FPS overlay, Fill Screen mode, auto-updater, and a bundled sensor service powered by LibreHardwareMonitor. Control Center profiles switch from the tray and bundle a Windows power plan and per-fan curves that keep running with the app closed; on supported AMD hardware they also set Ryzen PPT/TDC/EDC limits, Curve Optimizer undervolting and the Radeon or GeForce GPU power limit. Profiles can switch by themselves while a program runs (app rules), set the desktop background - one picture per screen - and drive Wallpaper Engine per profile: chosen wallpapers per screen, paused while gaming, or off. Lighting covers ASUS Aura Sync, ROG peripherals, Windows Dynamic Lighting devices and Philips Hue. Requires Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit). Free and open source, no telemetry, no bloat.
